questions.q: She ___ know about that. (I am very sure it is true)
questions.why: Упевнений висновок («я певен, що так») — *must*: *She must know about that.*

questions.q: He ___ be at home. (I am sure it is NOT true)
questions.why: Упевнене «ні» — *can't*: *He can't be at home.* *mustn't* — заборона, а не висновок.

questions.q: She ___ be sleeping now. (I'm about 40% sure)
questions.why: Близько 40% — невелика впевненість: *might*.

questions.q: She ___ have bought a flat. (I am sure it happened)
questions.why: Упевнений висновок про минуле — *must have* + третя форма.

questions.q: She ___ have bought a flat. (I am sure it did NOT happen)
questions.why: Упевнене «ні» про минуле — *can't have* + третя форма.

questions.q: Now: She must ___ sleeping.
questions.why: Висновок про дію зараз — *must be* + *-ing*.

questions.q: Past: She might ___ forgotten.
questions.why: Можливість у минулому — *might have* + третя форма.

questions.q: Which is the strongest logical conclusion?
questions.why: Найсильніший логічний висновок («я певен») — *must*. *might, may* — лише можливість, *should* — очікування.

questions.q: The negative deduction uses:
questions.why: Упевнене «не може бути» — *can't*. *mustn't* означає заборону, а не висновок.
*must have forgotten*.

questions.q: The lights are off. They ___ be out. (я впевнений)
questions.why: Світла немає — упевнений висновок: *They must be out.*

questions.q: That ___ be true! It's impossible!
questions.why: Неможливо — *can't* (або *couldn't*).

questions.q: I'm not sure where she is. She ___ be in the library.
questions.why: Невпевненість — *might / may / could*.

questions.q: He ___ have left already — his coat is gone.
questions.why: Пальта немає — упевнений висновок: *He must have left.*

questions.q: She ___ have seen us. She was looking the other way.
questions.why: Вона дивилася в інший бік — *can't / couldn't have seen us*.

questions.q: The phone is ringing. It ___ be my mother. She always calls at six.
questions.why: Вона завжди дзвонить о шостій — висновок *must*.

questions.q: You ___ be tired after such a long trip.
questions.why: Після довгої поїздки — логічний висновок *must*.

questions.q: They ___ have got lost. They should be here by now.
questions.why: Можливе пояснення — *may have got lost*.

questions.q: He ___ be working — his light is on at 2 am.
questions.why: Світло о другій ночі — *must be working*.
*must be very happy*.
*can't have finished* — не може бути.
questions.hint: Не може бути, що він уже закінчив.

questions.why: *might be sleeping* — можливо.

questions.q: ___ it be true? I can't believe it.
questions.why: Питання про можливість — *Could it be true?*

questions.q: You've been travelling all day. You ___ be exhausted.
questions.why: Висновок — *must be exhausted*.

questions.q: That ___ be Anna — she's in Paris this week.
questions.why: Вона в Парижі — тому *can't be Anna*.
